A QUICK START

Your flight, one call at a time.

1. Enter your flight details

Add your airline ICAO code, flight number, departure and arrival airports, aircraft, and departure stand. Select airports from the matching results, then choose “Create radio script”.

2. Listen to the ATIS

Use your pilot client to find the ATIS. Enter its information letter and QNH in hPa on the first script step, then use the arrow to continue.

3. Follow the controller steps

Your flight details are filled in automatically. Record assigned runways, routes, levels and squawk in the fields above each script. Blue text contains your details; amber text still needs an entry.

4. Listen and read back

The ATC lines are examples, not live transmissions or clearances. Follow the controller’s actual instructions and frequency handoffs. Use airport charts alongside this companion.

Flight details and script notes are saved in this browser tab. This companion does not file a flight plan or connect your simulator to VATSIM.
